claims.claim_text: Microsoft was CoreWeave's largest customer, accounting for 62% of revenue in 2024 (35% in 2023), with $1.2 billion of revenue recognized in 2024 under a February 2023 Microsoft Master Services Agreement.
claims.subject: CoreWeave
claims.source_quote: For the years ended December 31, 2023 and 2024, our largest customer was Microsoft, which accounted for 35% and 62% of our revenue, respectively... We have recognized revenue of $81 million and $1.2 billion for the years ended December 31, 2023 and 2024, respectively, pursuant to the Microsoft Master Services Agreement.

claims.claim_text: In March 2025 CoreWeave signed a Master Services Agreement with OpenAI under which OpenAI committed to pay up to approximately $11.9 billion through October 2030.
claims.subject: CoreWeave
claims.source_quote: As of March 11, 2025, subject to any termination described below and satisfaction of delivery and availability of service requirements, OpenAI has committed to pay us up to approximately $11.9 billion through October 2030.

claims.claim_text: NVIDIA is both a strategic investor in and key supplier to CoreWeave; CoreWeave deploys NVIDIA H100/H200/GH200 clusters and was the first cloud provider to make NVIDIA GB200 NVL72-based instances generally available.
claims.subject: CoreWeave
claims.source_quote: ...the first to bring NVIDIA H100, H200, and GH200 clusters into production at AI scale, and the first cloud provider to make NVIDIA GB200 NVL72-based instances generally available... NVIDIA Corporation (NVIDIA), and OpenAI OpCo, LLC (OpenAI)

claims.claim_text: As of December 31, 2024 CoreWeave operated 32 data centers running more than 250,000 GPUs supported by more than 360 MW of active power, with US facilities in 15 states plus the United Kingdom and Spain.
claims.subject: CoreWeave
claims.object_value: 32 data centers; 360+ MW active power; 15 US states + UK + Spain
claims.source_quote: ...grew further to 32 data centers running more than 250,000 GPUs in total and supported by more than 360 MW of active power as of December 31, 2024... data centers in the United States in 15 states and internationally in the United Kingdom, Spain...

claims.claim_text: CoreWeave reported $15.1 billion of remaining performance obligations (RPO) as of December 31, 2024, a 53% increase from $9.9 billion.
claims.subject: CoreWeave
claims.source_quote: $15.1 billion of remaining performance obligations, reflecting an increase of 53%, from $9.9 billion

claims.claim_text: CoreWeave names AI-native and enterprise customers including Cohere, Mistral AI, OpenAI, Replicate, and AI Enterprises such as Meta, IBM, Microsoft, and Jane Street.
claims.subject: CoreWeave
claims.object_value: Cohere, Mistral AI, OpenAI, Replicate, Meta, IBM, Microsoft, Jane Street
claims.source_quote: Our AI Lab customers include, among others, Cohere, Mistral AI, and OpenAI... with customers such as Meta, IBM, Microsoft, and Jane Street.

claims.claim_text: CoreWeave disclosed identified material weaknesses in internal control over financial reporting, an accumulated deficit of $1.5 billion, and $8.0 billion of total principal debt (DDTL facilities at 11-15% effective rates) as of December 31, 2024.
